description: SHA-256 of each file of the deploy's inputs that the repository itself generates (scripts/gcp/deploy-inputs.sh), pinned so that a dependency of the job that makes them cannot change what the deploy seeds (audit B08, review round 1). The synthetic fixture is deterministic: scripts/fhir/export-fixture.ts from the pinned Global ePI Type 2 example and fhir/mappings. A change to either changes it; record the new hash here, in the same reviewed pull request (CI's official-validation job makes the inputs and fails on a mismatch).
